scope: Static text/file/JSON reads only. No candidate execution, syntax check, browser, tests, module import or root/source/candidate edits. This review grants no runtime authorization.

artifactShapeChecks.qualification: Metadata shapes were read. Neither candidate nor its proposed runtime preflight was executed.

findings.title: Executable identity must gate replay input
findings.detail: frozenIdentityMatch for served script/CSS responses is recorded only. A mismatch or failed capture does not stop the replay import, so readinessPassed can be set on an unbound executable. The served HTML has an assertion, but associated executable/style assets do not.
findings.correction: After bounded capture settlement for initial production load and before replay file input, require successful captured declared JS/CSS responses and frozen identity equality. Preserve art failures/mismatches as diagnostic observations rather than broadening readiness.

findings.title: Seal response intake before completion
findings.detail: Response events can append tasks while Promise.allSettled(assetPromises) waits its original batch. Newly appended bodies/errors/manifest writes may still be running when Chromium closes and the receipt is serialized. Perbody timeout does not seal intake.
findings.correction: Unregister the response intake at a recorded final capture boundary, drain all admitted promises while Chromium remains alive, then serialize the final completion/captureerrors. Alternately implement bounded stable-count drain plus explicit intake seal; do not allow untracked new tasks.

positiveChecks: The ready predicate is identical to the original, including 60000 ms timeout and 20 ms polling.
Native input path contains one Import replay click and no Play, End, seek or combat action.
The initial menu match precedes the replay input, matching the existing application flow.
All same-origin /assets responses and failures are selected, including PNG and atlas JSON; console warning/error and pageerror callbacks are registered before navigation.
Actual manifest response bytes are retained unchanged with unique filenames.
Full observed state, current camera and readiness terms are read, with no private texture/frame hook claimed.
Preflight source/public/proof, dist and runtime comparisons use retained original hashes and pins; fresh output is external and owned port 5397 is fixed.
Admissions remain empty; no feature/group/stage promotion occurs.
completionLimits: replayImports increment before click records an attempt, not successful admission. Successful replay mode and tick 0/paused checks supply admission evidence.
Promise.race records a body timeout but does not cancel underlying browser body work; browser close remains required after bounded collection.
Private frame/texture completeness conditions remain unobserved.
Passing one fresh import cannot explain the preceding long sequence failure.
Root owns sole-slot release, preview/process supervision, original stdout/stderr/exit receipts, cleanup and retention.
